infer.unsupported: This phone can't run the on-device model.
infer.notInstalled: Download the on-device model to get summaries.
infer.busy: The on-device model is busy. Try again in a moment.
infer.failed: The on-device model stopped working. Try again in a moment.
infer.invalid: That model file can't be used.
infer.integrity: The download didn't match the expected model, so it was removed. Try again.
infer.noSpace: There isn't enough free space on this phone for the model.
infer.network: The model couldn't be downloaded. Check the connection and try again.
infer.tooLarge: There's too much text to summarize at once.
infer.incomplete: The summary was cut off, so it isn't shown.
infer.unusable: The summary was not usable. Try again.
infer.notEnough: Not enough recent output to summarize.
